Ontario’s Big City Mayors called on the province to declare a crisis on homelessness and drug addiction, fund more treatment programs for people who want help, and create a system to force people into treatment when voluntary programs don’t work.

A person in crisis should end up in care, not in a subway car, a hallway, or the back of a police car.

Some are in crisis again and again—a danger to themselves and others. For them, care can't be optional. That's a doctor's call. And it means nothing if there's no bed at the end of it.

A bed is for the worst night of your life. A home is for the rest of it. My job as mayor is both.

The count has doubled in three years. For three years, the people now demanding beds held seats, budgets, and votes at City Hall.

If speeches built beds, Toronto would have a surplus.

You were in the room. You had the votes. Where are the beds? Where are the homes?

Day one: supportive homes with care built in. A Toronto deal with Queen's Park and Ottawa. Proven models. Toronto scale. Transparent results. Receipts published every three months.

A bed is for the worst night of your life. A home is for the rest of it. My job as mayor is both. 

#TOpoli #Toronto2026

Toronto doesn't need strategists. It needs earned leadership. The votes of Torontonians are not a pie to be split up by strategists sitting behind closed doors somewhere — you have to earn them.

That means arriving with a sense of urgency, a program and a plan.

#TOpoli #Toronto2026

The mother who doesn't let her teenager take the TTC after dark isn't moved by statistics. She's moved by a platform and system that actually works. 
#TOpoli #Toronto2026

This is what Toronto's Mayor looks like when she has no answers.

Free TTC rides, in an election year. The timing isn't subtle. 

As Mayor, I'll have an immediate, substantive plan with real enforcement on streetcars and buses where the system bleeds the most, and fixed fare gates — not random blitzes. Then use the recovered revenue for reduced fares for the people who genuinely need help: seniors and students.

The TTC doesn't need more free rides. It needs to be managed properly. That's what competent leadership looks like.

#TOpoli #Toronto2026 #TTC

Decrees will only worsen the series of flawed decisions we've had so far and make congestion worse. 

If I'm elected mayor, I will ensure we have these agreed standards within 90 days, and a plan for obtaining that community buy-in that works for all of Toronto.

#TOpoli #Toronto2026
